newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRADE DEFICIT IN FIRST TWO MONTHS 72 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: TRADE DEFICIT IN FIRST TWO MONTHS 72 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvia's trade deficit in the first two months of the year was 72 million lats in current prices compared with a deficit of 72.52 million lats in the same period last year, the statistics committee said on Wednesday.

Latvia imported goods worth 204.33 million lats in the first two months of this year and exported 132.30 million lats. This compared with imports of 179.06 million lats in the same period of 1996 and 106.54 million lats of exports.
Russia was Latvia's largest trade partner, taking up 22.1 percent of exports and 19.2 percent of imports.
